invariants: Twelve ordered complete actual observations retain body-call identity/order, complete public results, scheduler outcome and every ordered tool/call and tool/result event field.
Missing metadata differs from explicit JSON null; false differs from zero and an empty object differs from an empty array. Presence survives copies, result handling and frozen publication.
Plain failure retains full public error/content without inventing durable error info; typed and skipped failure durable facts retain exactly original error.info without adding the public message.
Every tool-result message allocation is a distinct full lowercase UUIDv4. Only exact event.data.message.id allocations map by case and event position for cross-runtime comparison.

Fresh actual pinned Source guards all tracked original inputs and exact observer/case bytes before/after. Root and independent ownPython3.8.10 must import the complete independently approved native closure.

All value, presence, ordering, allocation, time, causal/surface, input, runtime and closure corruptions are refused. Every paired driver, regression lane and extracted receipt remains mandatory before a new clean full release qualifies integration.
identity: Exact twelve names in tool_durable_oracle.NAMES. Complete JSON digest preserves type and presence; no general UUID alias mapping, metadata omission or error-message normalization is allowed.
ownership: Actual tools and sessions are mounted through canonical providers; result message carrier uses the canonical helper. Input and module guards bind execution to the selected Root or own portable.
ordering: Three controlled exclusive calls per case; all ordered events, body calls and results remain captured. Before-abort and abort-after-first retain skipped-call facts.
errors: Complete public errors and exact durable typed info remain separate original fields. Older plain/skipped carriers and short/prefixed identifiers are rejected.
cancellation: Before-abort calls no body; body-abort stops after the first body and retains the original complete outcomes/events for subsequent skipped calls.
adaptation: Full UUIDv4 allocation values at one exact message-id path map to controlled event-position identities after shape and uniqueness validation; no other field is normalized.
open_questions: Arbitrary JSON-like graphs/cycles, every output/finalizer variant, additional contexts, all parallel scheduler/policy/profile combinations and the remaining Message ABI need their parent scopes.
